item.title: Electric Mayhem Talk Taking Over the Rock ‘n’ Roller Coaster With Kelly Clarkson, Jennifer Hudson & More at Disney World | Billboard News
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the world of entertainment and beyond. Today, we're talking to Janice and Floyd Pepper from the Electric Mayhem, the iconic Muppet band. They're here to share their experience taking over the Rock n' Roller Coaster at Disney World.
[Short music transition]
Host: Janice and Floyd, thanks for joining us. I heard the ride is incredible, with some amazing music. How did you choose the songs for the ride?
Janice: Ah, the songs kind of choose us, yeah. They're like friends, and you can't pick your friends' songs.
Floyd Pepper: [laughs] That's right. They're like old friends, and we just vibe with them.
Host: That makes sense. And speaking of friends, you worked with some amazing artists, like Kelly Clarkson and Jennifer Hudson. What was it like collaborating with them?
Janice: Oh, it was transcendent. Our auras were totally in sync.
Floyd Pepper: Yeah, everybody we worked with was groovy. It was a great experience.
Host: I can imagine. The ride does look intense, though. Were any of you scared to ride it?
Janice: [laughs] Well, none of us were scared, but... let's just say Miss Piggy might have been a little nervous.
Host: [laughs] Really? Miss Piggy, the confident and strong one?
Janice: [laughs] Yeah, well, maybe she's not as fearless as she seems.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks, Janice and Floyd, for sharing your experience with us. If you want to hear more, check out the full video. And don't forget to ride the Rock n' Roller Coaster at Disney World – it's a wild ride! [Outro music continues to play]
